name: Inoreader
tagline: Power RSS reader with rules, monitoring, search, and automations

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro listed at $9.99/month monthly and $7.50/month annually.

verdictSummary: A single-user RSS reader with rules and alerts can be built quickly on top of existing parsers, though not with Inoreader's scale and polish.
coreLoopDIY: Fetch feeds, dedupe items, apply keyword rules, tag/folder articles, and send alerts or exports.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for reliability and a power-user rules engine that keeps working while feeds break.

priorArt.name: Miniflux
priorArt.desc: Minimalist open-source RSS reader with self-hosting support.

notes: Useful power-user yes; the page can point to RSS as an open-protocol unlock.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Inoreader (Power RSS reader with rules, monitoring, search, and automations). Requirements:

- Core loop: Fetch feeds, dedupe items, apply keyword rules, tag/folder articles, and send alerts or exports.
- Needs: RSS parser.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: background jobs.
- Needs: email/webhook notifications.
- Needs: hosted app or local service.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: enterprise-scale feed handling; mobile apps; integrations.
